thread:
Alex (AE): Orchid Labs (Irish sub) ready to convert POC -> PO. Procurement insists signer for Irish entity but payments from UK parent. They also redlined HSM attestation and want it before first invoice. Need legal/finance/security input.

Maya (Legal): paste the redline? if attestation is a precedent to payment that's risky. We need acceptable POA formats listed and a fallback if docs delayed.

Alex (AE): redline snippet: `Section 4.1: "Provider must deliver HSM attestation within 10 business days of execution; failure permits Customer to withhold payment."` Procurement contact: proc@orchidlabs.eu.

Rohit (Security): we can provide attestation for Private/Dedicated via SOW. Hosted API does not include third-party HSM attestation. 10 business days is too short; ops needs 30-60 days.

Tess (FinOps): billing: we need to know billing entity for VAT and to map invoices. If UK parent pays, we need written intercompany payment instruction. PO number required to bind if they insist on PO procurement. Also notarized POA or eIDAS for signature acceptance.

Maya (Legal): propose counter: remove payment-withhold language. Replace with "Provider will use commercially reasonable efforts to provide scoped HSM attestation for Dedicated/Private deployments; timeline and fees to be set in SOW. Hosted plans are excluded." Add annex listing acceptable POA: notarized POA, eIDAS advanced cert, or corporate board resolution + ID. Also add 14-day cure period for missing POA before orderform termination.

Alex (AE): I'll push this with procurement, ask for PO#, VAT reg, and attach any POA they have. I'll flag that attestation may need SOW and 30-45 day lead.

esig-bot: Envelope created (env_orchid_0x9) for Order Form + Addendum 6 awaiting signatures.

Tess (FinOps): once PO# and billing entity confirmed, finance will prep invoice. If they want invoice to UK but contract to Ireland, need legal sign-off.

Rohit (Security): if they confirm Dedicated/BYO-HSM, I'll open a product-ops ticket to scope attestation. Maya 6 I'll send draft addendum now.

Maya (Legal): thanks 6 please include procurement contact and target sign date when you reply.
